# Nehemiah Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 471r–471v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_004_page_001.jpg

---

**4:1** And-it-was when Sanvallat heard that we were-building [bonim] the-wall, it-burned [va-yichar] to-him and-he-was-very-angry [va-yikh'as harbeh], and-he-mocked [va-yala'] the-Yehudim.

**4:2** And-he-said before his-brothers and-the-army [cheil] of-Shomeron, and-said, "What are-the-feeble [ha-amelallim] Yehudim doing? Will-they-restore [ha-ya'azvu] for-themselves? Will-they-sacrifice [ha-yizbachu]? Will-they-finish [ha-yekhallu] in-a-day [ba-yom]? Will-they-revive [ha-yechayu] the-stones [ha-avanim] from-the-heaps [aremot] of-rubble [ha-afer], and-they burned [niserefot]?"

**4:3** And-Toviyah the-Ammoni was beside-him [etslo] and-said, "Even [gam] what they are-building — if a-fox [shu'al] goes-up [ya'aleh] he-will-break-down [yifrotz] their-wall [chomat] of-stones [avneyhem]!"

**4:4** Hear [shema], our-God, for we-have-become [hayinu] a-contempt [buzah], and-turn-back [ve-hashev] their-reproach [cherpatam] upon their-own-head [rosham], and-give-them [u-tenem] as-plunder [le-vizah] in-a-land of-captivity [be-erets shivyah].

**4:5** And-do-not cover [al tekhas] over their-iniquity [avonam], and-their-sin [ve-chattatam] before-you let-not be-wiped-out [al timmacheh], for they-have-provoked [hikh'isu] before [le-neged] the-builders [ha-bonim].

**4:6** And-we-built the-wall, and-all the-wall was-joined [va-tiqasher] unto its-half [ad chetsyo], and-the-people had a-heart [lev] to-work [la'asot].

**4:7** And-it-was when Sanvallat and-Toviyah and-the-Aravim and-the-Ammonim and-the-Ashdodim heard that the-repair [arukhah] of-the-walls of-Yerushalayim was-going-up [altah], that the-breaches [ha-peratsim] had-begun to-be-closed [hechelu le-hissatem], and-it-burned to-them very-much [me'od].

**4:8** And-they-conspired [va-yiqsheru] all of-them together to-come to-fight [le-hillachem] against-Yerushalayim and-to-cause-confusion [to'ah] in-it.

**4:9** And-we-prayed [va-nitpalel] to our-God and-set [va-na'amid] a-watch [mishmeret] against-them day and-night because-of-them [mippeneyhem].

**4:10** And-Yehudah said, "The-strength [koach] of-the-burden-bearer [ha-sabbal] has-failed [kashel], and-the-rubble [he-afer] is-much [harbeh], and-we are-not able [lo nukhal] to-build [livnot] on the-wall."

**4:11** And-our-adversaries [tsarenu] said, "They-will-not know [lo yede'u] and-not see [ve-lo yir'u] until we-come into-their-midst [be-tokham] and-kill-them [va-haragnum] and-stop [ve-hishbatnu] the-work [ha-melakhah]."

**4:12** And-it-was when the-Yehudim who-dwelt beside-them came and-said to-us ten [eser] times [pe'amim], "From-all the-places [ha-meqomot] where you-turn [tashuvu], [they will be] upon-us."

**4:13** And-I-stationed [va-a'amid] from-below [mi-tachtiyyot] the-place, from-behind [me-acharey] the-wall, on-the-bare-places [ba-tsechichim], and-I-stationed the-people by-families [le-mishpechotam] with-their-swords [charvoteyhem] and-their-spears [romecheyhem] and-their-bows [qashtoteyhem].

**4:14** And-I-looked [va-ere] and-arose and-said to the-nobles [ha-chorim] and-to-the-officials [ha-seganim] and-to-the-rest of-the-people, "Do-not fear [al tire'u] before-them [mippeneyhem]; the-Lord [Adonay] the-great [ha-gadol] and-the-fearsome [ve-ha-nora] remember [zikhru], and-fight [ve-hilachamu] for your-brothers [acheykhem], your-sons [beneykhem] and-your-daughters [benoteykhem], your-wives [nesheykhem] and-your-houses [u-vatteykhem]."

**4:15** And-it-was when our-enemies [oyevenu] heard that it-was-known [nodah] to-us, and-God had-frustrated [va-yafer] their-counsel [atsatam], and-we-returned [va-nashuv] all-of-us to the-wall, each to-his-work [melakhto].

**4:16** And-it-was from that-day, half of-my-servants [ne'aray] were-doing [osim] the-work [ba-melakhah], and-half of-them were-holding [machazikim] the-spears [ha-remachim] and-the-shields [ha-maginnim] and-the-bows [ha-qeshtot] and-the-armor [ha-shiryanim]; and-the-officers [ha-sarim] were behind all the-house of-Yehudah.

**4:17** The-builders [ha-bonim] on the-wall and-the-carriers [ha-nos'im] of-burdens [ba-sevalot] — with-one of-his-hands [be-achat yado] doing [oseh] the-work [ba-melakhah] and-one holding [machaziq] the-weapon [ha-shelach].

**4:18** And-the-builders — each [had] his-sword [charbo] bound [asurim] on his-side [al motanav] and-building [u-vonim]. And-the-blower of-the-shofar [ha-toqe'a ba-shofar] was beside-me [etsli].

**4:19** And-I-said to the-nobles and-to-the-officials and-to-the-rest of-the-people, "The-work [ha-melakhah] is-great [harbeh] and-wide [rechavah], and-we are-separated [nifradim] on the-wall, far [rechoqim] one from-another [ish me-achiv].

**4:20** In-the-place [ba-maqom] where you-hear [tishme'u] the-sound [qol] of-the-shofar, there gather [tiqqavetsu] to-us; our-God will-fight [yillachem] for-us."

**4:21** And-we were-doing [osim] the-work, and-half of-them held [machazikim] the-spears from-the-rising [alot] of-the-dawn [ha-shachar] until the-coming-out [tset] of-the-stars [ha-kokhavim].

**4:22** Also at-that time I-said to-the-people, "Let-each man and-his-servant [na'aro] lodge [yalinu] inside [be-tokh] Yerushalayim, and-they-will-be for-us by-night a-guard [mishmeret] and-by-day the-work [ha-melakhah]."

**4:23** And-none-of-us — I and-my-brothers and-my-servants and-the-men of-the-guard who were-behind-me — none-of-us removed [poshtim] our-garments [begadenu]; each [had] his-weapon [shilcho] [and] the-water [ha-mayim].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **4:2 "Will they revive the stones?"** — Sanballat's mockery questions whether burned limestone can be reused; fire-damaged stone loses structural integrity, making this a practical as well as rhetorical jab.
2. **4:4-5 Imprecatory prayer** — Nehemiah's prayer for divine retribution follows ancient Near Eastern patterns and echoes psalmic imprecation (cf. Psalm 79:12).
3. **4:17 "one hand working, one holding a weapon"** — This vivid image of builder-warriors became iconic for the dual nature of faithful labor under threat.
4. **4:23 "his weapon and the water"** — The final phrase is textually difficult; *shilcho ha-mayim* may mean "each his weapon at the water" or may be corrupt. The Masoretic Text is preserved as-is.

*— EMET*
